title: Roadside Service Line Card — Road Hazard Protection
content:
Roadside service under Road Hazard Protection is a plan benefit of the Plus 36, Life-of-Tread and Commercial LT plans only. Each of those plans is credited a number of roadside service calls when coverage starts; a flat-tire change and a tow each use one call and are paid up to the plan's cap. The 12-Month, 24-Month and 36-Month plans carry no roadside service.

The six Road Hazard Protection plans, from rank 1 to rank 6, are the Crestline Road Hazard 12-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard 24-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard 36-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard Plus 36-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection and the Crestline Road Hazard Commercial LT Protection; the columns below use the short names 12-Month, 24-Month, 36-Month, Plus 36, Life-of-Tread and Commercial LT.

| | 12-Month | 24-Month | 36-Month | Plus 36 | Life-of-Tread | Commercial LT |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Roadside service calls granted when coverage starts | 0 | 0 | 0 | 3 | 4 | 2 |
| Roadside services dispatched | none | none | none | flat-tire change, tow | flat-tire change, tow | flat-tire change, tow |
| How a call is requested | not available | not available | not available | Crestline roadside line | Crestline roadside line | Crestline roadside line |
| Most paid for one flat-tire change | 0 USD | 0 USD | 0 USD | 75.00 USD | 85.00 USD | 75.00 USD |
| Most paid for one tow | 0 USD | 0 USD | 0 USD | 100.00 USD | 125.00 USD | 100.00 USD |
| Where a covered tow goes | not covered | not covered | not covered | nearest Crestline store | nearest Crestline store | nearest Crestline store |
| Unused calls carried past the term | no | no | no | no | no | no |

**Reading the card.**
- The calls are granted once, for the term; they do not renew and none carries to anything after the term.
- A cap is the most the plan pays the roadside provider for one service.

**Hypothetical illustrations.** A Life-of-Tread holder who has used one of the 4 calls has 3 left. A hypothetical tow billed at 140.00 on the Plus 36 plan is paid at its 100.00 cap.
